queries.query: What is the maximum allowed file upload size?
queries.reference_answer: The Hassan AI Engine supports a maximum document file upload size of 25 megabytes.

queries.query: How large can an uploaded document be?
queries.reference_answer: The maximum permitted document upload size is 25 megabytes.

queries.query: What file size limit applies when users upload documents?
queries.reference_answer: Document uploads are limited to 25 megabytes.

queries.query: Which file formats are supported for document upload?
queries.reference_answer: Supported file formats include PDF, TXT, and Markdown.

queries.query: Can the system ingest PDF, text, and Markdown documents?
queries.reference_answer: The document ingestion pipeline supports PDF, plain text TXT, and Markdown files.

queries.query: What document types can users upload to the engine?
queries.reference_answer: Users can upload PDF, TXT, and Markdown documents.

queries.query: What is the dimensionality of vector embeddings?
queries.reference_answer: The system uses 768-dimensional text embeddings.

queries.query: How many dimensions does each generated embedding contain?
queries.reference_answer: Each text embedding contains 768 dimensions.

queries.query: What vector size is used for semantic document search?
queries.reference_answer: Semantic search uses 768-dimensional vector embeddings.

queries.query: How does user authentication work with tokens?
queries.reference_answer: User authentication uses stateless JSON Web Tokens signed with HS256.

queries.query: Which signing algorithm is used for authentication JWTs?
queries.reference_answer: Authentication tokens use the HS256 cryptographic signing algorithm.

queries.query: What token mechanism protects authenticated users?
queries.reference_answer: Authenticated users are protected using stateless JSON Web Tokens signed with HS256.

queries.query: What index structure does pgvector use for similarity search?
queries.reference_answer: The vector search index uses pgvector with HNSW indexing.

queries.query: Which PostgreSQL vector index is used for fast similarity retrieval?
queries.reference_answer: PostgreSQL vector retrieval uses an HNSW index through pgvector.

queries.query: How are embedding vectors indexed for similarity search?
queries.reference_answer: Embedding vectors are indexed using pgvector HNSW indexing.

queries.query: What is the rate limit quota per user?
queries.reference_answer: The rate limit is 100 HTTP requests per minute per tenant.

queries.query: How many requests can a tenant make per minute?
queries.reference_answer: Each tenant is limited to 100 HTTP requests per minute.

queries.query: What request quota does Redis rate limiting enforce?
queries.reference_answer: Redis rate limiting enforces a fixed-window quota of 100 requests per minute per tenant.

queries.query: How are background tasks and document jobs processed asynchronously?
queries.reference_answer: Asynchronous document jobs are dispatched through Celery workers using Redis as the broker.

queries.query: Which technology handles asynchronous document processing?
queries.reference_answer: Celery task workers handle asynchronous document processing with Redis as the broker.

queries.query: What queue and worker system processes background document jobs?
queries.reference_answer: Background document jobs are processed by Celery workers with Redis providing the broker.

queries.query: Where is chat conversation history cached for streaming?
queries.reference_answer: Chat session context is cached in Redis memory buffers for low-latency token streaming.

queries.query: Which storage system caches chat context during streaming?
queries.reference_answer: Redis is used to cache chat session context during token streaming.

queries.query: How is conversation context kept available for fast streaming responses?
queries.reference_answer: Conversation context is stored in Redis memory buffers to support low-latency streaming.

queries.query: How is CORS configured for client origins?
queries.reference_answer: CORS permits requests only from configured trusted client origins.

queries.query: Which origins are allowed to access the API through CORS?
queries.reference_answer: Only configured trusted client domain origins are permitted by CORS.

queries.query: What restriction is applied to cross-origin API requests?
queries.reference_answer: Cross-origin requests are restricted to configured trusted client domains.

queries.query: What preprocessing happens during document parsing and extraction?
queries.reference_answer: Document preprocessing performs text pagination, layout extraction, and semantic chunk-boundary deduplication.

queries.query: How is document text prepared before it is indexed?
queries.reference_answer: Document text undergoes pagination, layout extraction, and semantic chunk-boundary deduplication during preprocessing.

queries.query: Which preprocessing steps are applied to extracted document content?
queries.reference_answer: Extracted content is processed with text pagination, layout extraction, and semantic chunk-boundary deduplication.
